tutorial_control_move_text:
Hi, welcome to the training ground. Let's start collecting
all the Magic Beans! DRAG the BLUE CONTROL to move.
Stand on the Magic Bean for a while to pick it up.
tutorial_control_attack_text:
Good job! Now open the Treasure Chest. DRAG the RED
CONTROL to aim, and RELEASE to throw snowballs. Or TAP
the RED CONTROL to automatically aim and throw a snowball.
tutorial_stamina_bar_desc_text:
Great! The GREEN BAR above your character's head shows
your stamina, which takes some time to recover.
tutorial_pickup_all_items_text:
Now go collect all the items on the ground. Stand on
the item for a while to pick it up.
tutorial_equipment_desc_text:
Good job! You've equipped the Snowball Bucket and
gained the ability to charge a huge snowball.
tutorial_control_supper_attack_text:
Now let's charge a huge snowball. PRESS and HOLD the
YELLOW CONTROL until the GREEN BAR starts to decrease,
then DRAG to aim, RELEASE to throw.
tutorial_use_item_text:
Great! Now TAP the Potion of Invulnerability in the
Inventory Bar and use it to make you resistant to damage.
tutorial_find_enemy_text: Well done! Now find the enemy and knock him/her out.
tutorial_objective_text:
Good job! A battle for survival is about to begin.
Take down the others and be the last one standing.
tutorial_collect_magicbeans_text:
Magic Beans can make your snowball more powerful.
Collect as many as possible. Good luck!
tutorial_show_equipment_bar_text: TAP here to see the equipment obtained.
